Flow diagram illustrating the Memorandum Joint Venture system. Two distinct boxes represent "Venturer A's Books" and "Venturer B's Books", both feeding data into a central "Memorandum Joint Venture Account" on a rough sheet. Arrows show Venturer A's costs (₦160,000) and revenues (₦120,000) and Venturer B's costs (₦85,000) and revenues (₦215,000) flowing into the Memorandum Account to calculate a final profit of ₦90,000, which is then split and sent back to their respective books.
